rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial way to describe doing something with extreme zeal.

example.english: They trained fanatically to win the match.
example.traditional: 佢為咗贏場波，瘋狂咁操練。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 zo2 jeng4 coeng4 bo1 fung1 kwong4 gam3 cou1 lin6

rows.note: Use this when the extreme enthusiasm is focused on a cause, belief, movement, team, or celebrity.

example.english: The fans supported this team fanatically.
example.traditional: 啲球迷狂熱咁支持呢隊波。
example.jyutping: di1 kau4 mai4 kwong4 jit6 gam3 zi1 ci4 ne1 deoi6 bo1

rows.note: Use this when the fanatical manner particularly suggests obsessive devotion or infatuation.

example.english: They fanatically followed their idol and even stopped going to work.
example.traditional: 佢痴迷咁追星，連工都唔返。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ci1 mai4 gam3 zeoi1 sing1 lin4 gung1 dou1 m4 faan2
